comment: Scripted tab switching for fixtures/scenes/tabbar_basic.json (M10 UITabBarController). Item centers: Home x=101.75, Search x=187.5, platter row y=439. Capture 0.05 = initial state (Home selected: tinted item + capsule, 'Home screen' content). Tap Search at 0.10/0.18 -> capture 0.35: capsule + tint move to Search, Home's content view is swapped out (Search tab has no content). Tap Home at 0.50/0.58 -> capture 0.80: Home restored WITH its content label (tab state preserved across the round trip).
